detail.longDescription: ☄️ NEW: New # research suggests giant impacts during the late stages of rocky # planet formation could help young worlds retain their primordial # atmospheres . The impacts add mass and drive some heat deep underground, raising gravitational binding more than surface heating, which may explain why sub-Neptunes and super-Earths are so abundant among # exoplanets . 👉 https://www. universetoday.com/articles/gia nt-impacts-help-rocky-planets-retain-their-atmospheres # space # astronomy # earth # science # geology # solarsystem
